purpose: The transport security profile every link between RealityEngine entities must meet (RealityEngine_CI#668; ENGINEERING_CONTRACT.md, 'every link is TLS 1.3'). Tightening the profile is a change to this file alone; each release records the profileId it was certified under.

keyExchangeGroups.note: Post-quantum hybrid key exchange wherever both ends support it. A peer without it may use a fallback group; nothing else is accepted.

certificates.issuer: the install's own CA, issued by scripts/lib/re_pki.py (RealityEngine_CI#726)
certificates.instanceIdentity: An engine instance's certificate carries the URI SAN urn:uuid:<instance_uuid> (RealityEngine_CI#296), so the handshake proves which instance is speaking.
certificates.verification: Hostname and identity checks are always on. Disabling verification is forbidden outside a named test fixture.

authentication.serviceToService: mTLS: both ends present a certificate from the install CA
authentication.usersAndDevices: TLS server authentication, with user or device authentication on top

refused: plaintext on any link, loopback included
certificate verification disabled outside a named test fixture
externalParties: Held strictly: a link to an outside party that does not meet this profile is refused, not recorded as an exception.
